The Artist

Ink on Paper
by Roma

I make intricate ink drawings influenced by my spirituality — dense, precise linework that builds into spirals, eyes, geometric forms and symbolic landscapes. Each piece is worked entirely by hand, often over many hours, no rulers used.

These prints are faithful reproductions of the original works, printed on good quality paper using giclée printing. Every print is signed by me before shipping.

Follow the process at @roma_art27

About the Prints

Every print in this shop is made from a photograph of the original hand-drawn artwork. The originals are drawn in ink — sometimes with coloured pencil or marker — on cartridge or watercolour paper.

Prints are produced on good quality archival matte paper using professional giclée printing, capturing the fine detail of the linework. Each is signed by hand before being carefully rolled and shipped in a protective tube.

🖊️
Hand-drawn originals
